body:
A search committed before acknowledgement loss could remain pending after its session expired. Terminal replay now returns the owned durable receipt independently of card availability, preserving card ownership/TTL and the one-debit quota ledger.

Create/reset also recover after a lost acknowledgement. Additive migration 0072_ai_session_commands stores owned command receipts atomically with session creation/replacement. The client preserves each source/version/key across ambiguous failures; concurrent retries recover the same live session at cap=1/2. A separately gated identity bootstrap acknowledges the guest cookie before keyed create can commit.

The UI now handles guest 401 on query, pre-reservation QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, transient synchronization failures, session loss and stale cards/cursors separately. Drafts and displayed cards survive recovery; missing cards resynchronize the editable session rather than discarding it. Pagination waits while a query or session command is unsettled, preserving recovery keys.

Addresses original PR402-01…10 and repeat-review NEW-01…10, plus the additional pending-pagination race and failed-reset rollback checks. The FactPipeline running/lease autoflush ordering is also corrected. Reproducible commands and implementation details: PR_402_REMEDIATION_REPORT.md.

Validated final HEAD: **2b2fb1b04aeee188f2dd41da2ba5c9f57d767491**.

Local verification on the final code:
- Full Ruff and mypy: passed; 1,362 backend unit tests passed (15 expected skips).
- PostgreSQL/Redis/facts/session/browser-boundary suites: 374 passed, no skips.
- 33 Playwright frontend contracts passed; lint/i18n, TypeScript and production build passed.
- Real Chromium HTTP → same-origin frontend/router → PostGIS: four recovery scenarios passed. The browser itself transmits Cookie/Origin/CSRF and processes Set-Cookie; Secure/HttpOnly/Path/SameSite are asserted. These tests also ran successfully in combined CI.
- Full migration chain and Alembic metadata checks passed. Production CI additionally passed full PostgreSQL/PostGIS and MinIO integration suites.

The previous 4ec88687 Ruff failures are documented; they are superseded by these successful runs. The older optional UI→ASGI bridge remains explicitly limited and skips without AI_UI_TEST_URL; the real HTTP tests run in CI with AI_UI_DIST_PATH. Test parsers are offline. No merge or production deployment has been performed.
